WITH group_averages AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        AVG(ANA) AS avg_ana
    FROM Examination
    WHERE ID IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ID
),
overall_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_ana) AS mean_group_avg
    FROM group_averages
)
SELECT
    g.ID,
    g.avg_ana,
    g.avg_ana - o.mean_group_avg AS excess
FROM group_averages AS g
CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS o
WHERE g.avg_ana > o.mean_group_avg
ORDER BY excess DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Groups with no non-NULL ANA values have a NULL average and are excluded from the overall mean and results, as AVG ignores NULL values.
